title: Gus and the Truck of Long Boards
synopsis: A material-delivery flatbed brings new timber and roofing sheets, while Dan brings boxed fixings in his blue enclosed truck. Gus compares board lengths with his own steps and learns why the loads need different vehicles.
continuity_state: Before: The little side shelter by the farm wagon door has a leaky roof-wall joint and weathered edge board. Only that area is closed. Mr. Lee and Farmer Ruth have planned a focused replacement, and the wheelbarrow is in the dry barn. After: A separate open-bed lumber delivery truck has brought strapped bundles of timber and roofing panels using the long farm road. Dan has brought sealed fasteners and small items in his usual blue box truck. All supplies are safely unloaded/stored by adults in a marked work yard; the old shelter is not yet rebuilt.
